'''Birlen Pena''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Black Ajah]]. She was first mentioned in [[Verin Mathwin]]'s book, naming her to be a [[Darkfriend]]. It is unknown which of the seven [[Ajah]]s she also belongs to, but being in the Tower just before reunification means that she was not a Blue.

== Activities ==
She escapes from the [[White Tower]] just after [[Egwene al'Vere]] becomes [[Amyrlin Seat]], and avoids re-swearing on the [[Oath Rod]].
